claim.zh: 十年期美债收益率这一轮上涨,主要是"时间的租金"(实际利率/期限溢价),不是通胀预期;通胀数据走软也压不下来。
claim.en: The latest leg up in the 10-year yield is mostly rent on time (real yields / term premium), not inflation expectations; softer inflation prints will not pull it down.

test.zh: 到 11 月初:十年期收益率仍在 5% 以上,且 10 月 1 日以来十年期实际利率(DFII10)的变动大于十年期通胀预期(T10YIE)的变动。
test.en: By early November: the 10-year yield is still above 5%, and since October 1 the 10-year real yield (DFII10) has moved more than 10-year breakeven inflation (T10YIE).

claim.zh: 九月非农初值 2.9 万只是第一次报价,后续修正幅度会大到改变解读。
claim.en: September's +29k payrolls print is only a first quote; later revisions will be large enough to change the story.

test.zh: 11 月初公布十月非农时,九月数据的修正幅度达到 3 万人以上(上修或下修都算)。
test.en: When October payrolls are released in early November, September is revised by 30k or more in either direction.

claim.zh: 富士康营收大增验证不了 AI 需求,同一条供应链上的数字是回声;真正的证据在链条另一头的终端收入。
claim.en: Foxconn's revenue surge cannot verify AI demand — numbers on the same supply chain echo each other; the real evidence sits at the far end, in end-customer revenue.

test.zh: 十月底三季报季:微软、谷歌、亚马逊、Meta 的资本开支同比增速,仍明显高于它们云业务/AI 相关收入的同比增速。
test.en: In the late-October earnings season, capex growth at Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon and Meta still clearly outpaces growth in their cloud / AI-related revenue.

claim.zh: AI 资本开支本身就是利率的出价人,和房贷、国债抢同一批储蓄,会让长端利率更难降。
claim.en: AI capex is itself a bidder for rates, competing with mortgages and Treasuries for the same savings, which makes long rates harder to bring down.

test.zh: 到 11 月底:大型科技公司第四季度发债规模明显放大,同时十年期收益率没有回到 10 月 7 日以下。
test.en: By end-November: big-tech bond issuance in Q4 clearly picks up, while the 10-year yield has not fallen back below its October 7 level.

claim.zh: OpenAI 收入"从 700 亿降到 500 亿"主要是毛额和净额两种记法的差,不是需求下修。
claim.en: The OpenAI revenue "cut" from about $70B to $50B is mostly gross-versus-net accounting, not a demand downgrade.

test.zh: 后续报道或披露确认两个数字口径不同(毛额/净额),且没有出现 OpenAI 下调收入预期的消息。
test.en: Later reporting or disclosure confirms the two figures use different bases (gross vs net), and no report emerges of OpenAI cutting its revenue outlook.

claim.zh: 比特币回到 ETF 持有人平均成本附近时,流出主要是回本离场的人;价格离成本线越远,流出越少。
claim.en: When bitcoin returns to ETF holders' average cost, outflows are mostly break-even sellers leaving; the further price moves above that line, the smaller the outflows.

test.zh: 10 月 10 日到 11 月 10 日:比特币收在 ETF 平均成本附近的交易日,现货 ETF 净流出的天数多于价格明显高于成本线的交易日。
test.en: From October 10 to November 10: on days bitcoin closes near the ETF average cost, net outflow days are more frequent than on days it closes clearly above that line.

claim.zh: 指数持平藏着撕裂:当天领跌的存储股不是一日噪音,是资金在板块间换手。
claim.en: A flat index hid a split: the memory stocks that led the decline that day were not one-day noise but money rotating between sectors.

test.zh: 10 月 12 日收盘到 11 月 12 日收盘,美光跑输标普 500。
test.en: From the October 12 close to the November 12 close, Micron underperforms the S&P 500.

claim.zh: 被剔掉的能源通胀不会消失,会通过预期和二轮成本绕回核心通胀。
claim.en: The energy inflation that core strips out does not disappear; it loops back into core through expectations and second-round costs.

test.zh: 十月 CPI(11 月中公布):核心 CPI 同比不低于九月的 2.6%。
test.en: October CPI (released mid-November): core CPI year-over-year is no lower than September's 2.6%.

claim.zh: 趋势走到后段,好财报只是收据:台积电再好的成绩也换不回加速度,股价难回前高。
claim.en: Late in a trend, a strong report is only a receipt: TSMC's results cannot buy back acceleration, and the stock will struggle to regain its high.

test.zh: 到 11 月 18 日,台积电 ADR 收盘仍低于 10 月 5 日的收盘高点。
test.en: By November 18, TSMC's ADR still closes below its October 5 closing high.

claim.zh: 指引区间被定价的是上沿:通用汽车收窄区间、砍掉上沿,中点不变也是利空。
claim.en: Guidance is priced at the ceiling: by narrowing its range and trimming the top, GM delivered bad news even with an unchanged midpoint.

test.zh: 到 11 月 20 日,通用汽车股价仍收在财报前(10 月 17 日)收盘价下方。
test.en: By November 20, GM still closes below its pre-earnings close of October 17.

claim.zh: Meta 自由现金流转负是换了出资人:AI 开支的钱从自己的现金流转到债券市场。
claim.en: Meta's negative free cash flow means a new payer: AI spending is being funded by the bond market instead of its own cash flow.

test.zh: 到年底前,Meta 再次发行长期债券(或公告发债计划),且四季度没有恢复回购。
test.en: Before year-end, Meta issues long-term bonds again (or announces a plan to), and does not resume buybacks in Q4.

claim.zh: 加息先发生在曲线上:两年期比联邦基金利率高出八十多个基点,美联储迟早要跟上。
claim.en: Hikes happen on the curve first: with the 2-year 80-plus basis points above fed funds, the Fed will follow.

test.zh: 12 月 FOMC 加息;或者 12 月会议前两年期收益率与有效联邦基金利率的差距收窄到 30 个基点以内(说明曲线回头了,判断错)。
test.en: The December FOMC hikes; if instead the 2-year/effective fed funds gap narrows below 30bp before that meeting, the curve backed off and the call was wrong.

claim.zh: 进口那一行的减号不是拖累,是退货:美国本土需求依然强,GDP 只是扣掉了外国造的部分。
claim.en: The minus sign on imports is not a drag but a refund: US domestic demand is still strong, and GDP simply subtracts what was made abroad.

test.zh: 三季度 GDP 第二次估算(11 月下旬):私人国内最终销售增速仍在 4% 以上。
test.en: Q3 GDP second estimate (late November): final sales to private domestic purchasers still grow above 4%.

claim.zh: AMD的客户权证不是一次性噪音,是随股价重估、用股价计价的折扣:它会作为负债按季度重估,损益落在经营之外,方向跟着股价走。
claim.en: AMD's customer warrants are not one-off noise but a discount priced in its own stock: carried as a liability, remeasured every quarter below operating income, moving with the share price.

test.zh: 到 2026 年 12 月 7 日,AMD 向 SEC 提交的 2026 年三季度 10-Q 显示:客户权证按公允价值列为负债、每季度重估,公允价值变动计入营业利润以下(其他收入/费用),且注明主要随 AMD 股价变动;若 10-Q 显示该变动冲减营收或计入营业利润之内,或权证被列为权益、不再重估,则判断错。
test.en: By December 7, 2026, AMD's Q3 2026 10-Q on SEC EDGAR shows the customer warrants carried as a liability at fair value, remeasured quarterly, with changes recorded below operating income (other income/expense) and attributed mainly to AMD's stock price. If the 10-Q instead books the change against revenue or inside operating income, or classifies the warrants as equity with no remeasurement, the call is wrong.

claim.zh: AI资本开支是一张账单:市场开始把数据中心建设被拖慢定价为付钱方的利好、收钱方的利空,这种分化不是一天的噪音。
claim.en: AI capex is a bill: the market has started pricing slower data center buildout as good for the payers and bad for the payees, and this split is not one day of noise.

test.zh: 以美东2026年11月4日收盘为基准(费城半导体指数10268.65、微软555.80美元、亚马逊266.03美元),到美东2026年12月31日收盘,费城半导体指数的涨跌幅低于微软与亚马逊两只股票涨跌幅的简单平均,则判对;高于或相等则判错。
test.en: Using US Eastern closes on November 4, 2026 as the base (PHLX Semiconductor Index 10,268.65, Microsoft $555.80, Amazon $266.03): if by the close on December 31, 2026 the index's percentage change is below the simple average of Microsoft's and Amazon's percentage changes, the call is right; if it is equal or higher, the call is wrong.
